notes: Strict Pommard AOC specifications from the effective cahier des charges homologated by decree n°2011-1510. Pommard is red only. Accessory Chardonnay, Pinot Blanc and Pinot Gris are permitted only as mixed vineyard plantings up to 15% per parcel, so the authoritative positive path remains 100% Pinot Noir.
